 At Survivor Series, Charlotte Flair, Stephanie Vaquer, Alexa Bliss, Tatum Paxley and Bayley will battle Fatal Influence, Jade Cargill and Michin in a WarGames Match.
En route to the career-altering showdown, The Queen will take on The Storm to determine which team will get the WarGames advantage.
Don't miss all the action on SmackDown, tonight at 8 ET/7 CT on USA.
